_about: Every item Amodu can carry (player/items.gd). kind: material, food, tool, weapon, light, upgrade (made once, it changes him: the woven bag). stack: most in one pack slot. food/water/heal: what eating, drinking or using it gives (0-100 scale). weapon: the Weapons id a crafted weapon becomes (it goes on his body, not in the pack). icon: the model its icon is rendered from (tools/render_icons.gd): a garden prop id, 'nature:<id>' for a Poly Haven model, 'weapon:<id>', or 'made:<shape>' for a shape the tool builds. The world's gathering (the environment session) emits these ids.

leaf.name: Leaf
leaf.desc: Cut from a fallen leaf with the knife or the axe. Roofs, wraps and bedding.

clover.name: Clover leaf
clover.desc: Soft three-part leaf, picked by hand. Good for bandages.

fibre.name: Grass fibre
fibre.desc: Loose bundles of dry grass lie on bare soil: pick them up. Cut grass and weeds give it too. Three make twine.

sprig.name: Sprig
sprig.desc: A thin green stalk sprouting from the soil: cut it with your knife. Handles for the first tools.

grass_plank.name: Grass plank
grass_plank.desc: Fell a grass stalk with the axe, then chop the fallen stalk into planks. Walls, floors, frames.

twine.name: Twine
twine.desc: Three grass fibre twisted into cord, by hand (Crafting). It holds tools and buildings together.

twig.name: Twig
twig.desc: Chopped from a fallen twig lying in the grass, with the stone axe: at your size a twig is a log. Handles, frames, firewood.

pebble.name: Pebble
pebble.desc: Pebbles lie loose on bare soil and the ant roads: pick them up. A big stone smashed with the hammer gives more. Axe and hammer heads.

bark.name: Bark chip
bark.desc: Chopped from bark chips in the mulch, with the axe. Burns well and makes plates.

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.desc: A chunk of mushroom. Filling, but better roasted.

grass_seeds.name: Grass seeds
grass_seeds.desc: A handful of seeds from a seed head. A bite to eat.

silk.name: Spider silk
silk.desc: Cut from spider silk with your knife: trip lines and webs. Rope, bindings and nets.

resin.name: Resin
resin.desc: Sap oozing out of the apple tree's wood, west of the lawn: droplets at the roots' foot to pick up, clumps to smash with the hammer. Torches and glue.

amber.name: Amber
amber.desc: Old resin gone hard and clear as glass.

rubber.name: Rubber
rubber.desc: A springy scrap of rubber. Slings and seals.

clay.name: Clay
clay.desc: Smash a broken pot shard with the hammer. Pots, bricks and flasks.

flint.name: Flint
flint.desc: A sharp-edged stone from deep in the soil. Better blades.

worm_slime.name: Worm slime
worm_slime.desc: Slippery slime from a worm tunnel.

root_sap.name: Root sap
root_sap.desc: Sweet sap from a root. It heals a little.

glow_spores.name: Glow spores
glow_spores.desc: Spores that shine in the dark. Lamps.

iron_pin.name: Iron pin
iron_pin.desc: A pin from the big people's world. Strong metal.

beetle_shell.name: Beetle shell
beetle_shell.desc: A plate of hard shell. Armour and shields.

calcite.name: Calcite
calcite.desc: Chalky pearls from a worm's gut. The ants use them in potions.

mite_fuzz.name: Mite fuzz
mite_fuzz.desc: Soft red fuzz from a velvet mite (it fights back). Bedding and padding.

bug_meat.name: Raw bug meat
bug_meat.desc: From an aphid or a springtail. Filling raw, better roasted.

honeydew.name: Honeydew
honeydew.desc: The sweet drop an aphid makes. Food and a good drink.

crumb.name: Crumb
crumb.desc: A crumb of cake. Sweet and filling.

apple_chunk.name: Apple chunk
apple_chunk.desc: Juicy windfall apple. Food and a little water.

strawberry.name: Wild strawberry
strawberry.desc: Sweet and wet. Food and water.

sugar.name: Sugar crystal
sugar.desc: A crystal of sugar from a spill. A burst of energy.

roasted_meat.name: Roasted bug meat
roasted_meat.desc: Bug meat cooked over a fire. Far more filling than raw.

roasted_mushroom.name: Mushroom skewer
roasted_mushroom.desc: Mushroom roasted on a sprig over a fire. Filling, and a little water in it.

woven_bag.name: Woven bag
woven_bag.desc: A bag of woven fibre on your back: four more pack slots. Made at the workbench, once.

clay_flask.name: Clay flask
clay_flask.desc: An empty clay flask. Drink at the Rut and it fills too.

flask_water.name: Flask of water
flask_water.desc: Water carried in a clay flask. Drink it anywhere; the flask stays.

bandage.name: Leaf bandage
bandage.desc: Clover wrapped with fibre. Heals when you use it.

torch.name: Resin torch
torch.desc: A twig with resin on the end. Light in the dark.

stone_knife.name: Stone knife
stone_knife.desc: Always at your hip. Cuts fibre, silk and vines.

stone_axe.name: Stone axe
stone_axe.desc: Chops grass and stems, and fights well.

stone_hammer.name: Stone hammer
stone_hammer.desc: Slow and heavy. Cracks shells and stone.

thorn_spear.name: Spear
thorn_spear.desc: Long reach. Keeps big things at a distance.

leaf_saddle.name: Leaf saddle
leaf_saddle.desc: A padded leaf to strap on a ladybird you've befriended, so you can ride it.
